# 74123 - Retriggerable monostable multivibrator with clear

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74123.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74123.json)

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 13 | 1Q = PULSE1 | High for tw after a trigger; trigger = rising edge of T where T = 1CLR AND 1A' AND 1B; low at once when 1CLR is low. |
| 4 | /1Q = NOT PULSE1 | Complement of Q. |
| 5 | 2Q = PULSE2 | High for tw after a trigger; trigger = rising edge of T where T = 2CLR AND 2A' AND 2B; low at once when 2CLR is low. |
| 12 | /2Q = NOT PULSE2 | Complement of Q. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 2

Changes on: trigger edges on A, B or CLR (each section)

- CLR low: Q = 0, Q' = 1 at once (overriding clear ends the pulse)
- A high or B low (steady): no trigger; Q low, Q' high once any started pulse has ended
- CLR high, A low, B rising: trigger
- CLR high, A falling, B high: trigger
- CLR rising, A low, B high: trigger
- Retriggerable: a new trigger during the pulse restarts the timing, so the pulse ends tw after the last trigger (plus tPLH); retrigger pulses starting before 0.22 * Cext (pF) ns after the first trigger are ignored
- Pulse width for Cext &gt; 1000 pF: tw = K * RT * Cext * (1 + 0.7/RT), K = 0.28 for the '123, RT in kOhm, Cext in pF, tw in ns
- With the protection diode of datasheet Figure 2 (electrolytic Cext or when CLR is used): tw = KD * RT * Cext * (1 + 0.7/RT), KD = 0.25 for the '123
- For Cext &lt;= 1000 pF the width is read from datasheet Figure 4 (graph); no formula

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74123: Rext 5 to 50 kOhm, Cext no restriction, wiring capacitance at Rext/Cext max 50 pF, input pulse duration min 40 ns. Clear input IIL -3.2 mA, IIH 80 uA; data inputs -1.6 mA, 40 uA. The datasheet calls only the 'LS122/'LS123 B input Schmitt; the 74123 is not. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, Cext 0, Rext 5 kOhm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Q | PLH | 22 | 33 |
| B | Q | PLH | 19 | 28 |
| A | Q' | PHL | 30 | 40 |
| B | Q' | PHL | 27 | 36 |
| CLR | Q | PHL | 18 | 27 |
| CLR | Q' | PLH | 30 | 40 |

## Notes

The SN74LS123 has different figures (same datasheet, page 6); this file is the 74123.
